observable_signal: Chromatic artifact mask from image pixels
evidence: 500/500 images contain colored artifacts; Conservative repair was selected for signal preservation
proposed_action: Apply deterministic Conservative artifact repair before detection
limitation: Artifact detector and repair were validated on this corpus only

evidence: B2 achieved 1121 TP / 51 FP / 26 FN and F1 0.96680 on 4-fold OOF
proposed_action: Use B2 as the report-selected development detector
limitation: No untouched external held-out final evaluation

evidence: Confidence 0.25 is the reporting threshold; 0.40 was an EDA candidate with P 0.97394 and R 0.97733
proposed_action: Return a positive detection with localization and confidence
limitation: Production cost and calibration were not observed

evidence: Stage 3 and Stage 6 show confidence-related misses; candidate-local routing did not yield a useful fixed rule
proposed_action: Flag uncertain predictions for secondary inspection or human review
limitation: Threshold selection on the same development data would be optimistic

evidence: Localization failures remain a distinct error mode; M6 reduced their count on Fold1 without global benefit
proposed_action: Flag unstable boxes or inconsistent localization for review
limitation: A deployable stability test was not validated across all folds

observable_signal: Predicted bbox size and predicted-box local visibility
evidence: Size and image-derived visibility are associated with misses, but size-only routing was not supported
proposed_action: Use only observable prediction-derived versions after separate validation
operational_status: Not approved as a production router
limitation: GT bbox size/contrast/CNR-like values are diagnostic and cannot be used directly at inference

observable_signal: Inferred product-edge proximity and abnormal background gradient
evidence: Both show exploratory associations with B0 misses
proposed_action: Consider as quality-review cues only after inference-time validation
operational_status: Not approved as a production router
limitation: Product boundary is inferred; acquisition groups and background variables are confounded

observable_signal: No detector positive and no validated risk flag
evidence: All 500 development images are GT-positive; true-negative behavior was not measured
proposed_action: Permit PASS only after normal-negative validation and operational calibration
limitation: Specificity, true-negative PASS rate, and real reinspection workload cannot be estimated

evidence: Patch/fusion/local-redetection oracle complementarity did not translate to deployable Fold1 improvement
proposed_action: Send flagged cases to a separate inspection or human review process
limitation: Human-review time and secondary-inspection yield were not measured
